info.title: FOC local invoice dashboard
info.description: Local invoice dashboard with Stage 6 admin controls. Loopback only. GET routes are read-only. Protected POST commands pause/resume queue consumption and retry/reprocess selected jobs without editing invoices. Startup management is provided by the local run_system.py CLI, outside the HTTP API. Manual invoice editing creates preserved versions through the worker without repeating OCR.

servers.description: Default local dashboard port; configurable at launch.

On-demand verified transformed source-page PNG, optionally highlighted.
